description: Caller corrects the plate, the time and the callback number; the later value must win.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Horizon Assurance, good morning, this is Karim. How can I help?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hello, I had an accident yesterday in Casablanca and I need to declare it.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Of course. Your policy number please?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. And your full name?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Sarah Benali.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mrs Benali. What is the registration of your car?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The plate is 1234-A-56, no sorry, 1234-B-56. B like Beirut.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: 1234-B-56, noted. When did it happen?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yesterday afternoon, around three pm... actually no, it was closer to half past four, I had just picked up my son from school.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: So yesterday, the twentieth, at about four thirty. Where was it?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: On Boulevard Zerktouni, near the Twin Center.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What damage is there on your car?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The front left wing is pushed in and the left headlight is smashed.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Was anyone injured?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My son has a small cut on his forehead. We went to the clinic, he got two stitches, he's fine now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'm glad he's okay. Was another vehicle involved?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, a taxi. The driver is Hassan Ouazzani, the taxi plate is 56789-A-6 and he's insured with Wafa Assurance.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Did the police come?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, they came and gave us a report, the number is 0457 slash 2026.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: 0457/2026. Any witnesses?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no witnesses, everyone just drove past.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And a phone number to reach you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: 06 61 23 45 67. Wait, no, sorry, it ends in 76. 06 61 23 45 76.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: 06 61 23 45 76. Thank you, we'll call you back shortly.
